title: In-Place Pod Vertical Scaling (InPlacePodVerticalScaling GA in 1.35+)
content: In Kubernetes 1.35+ (and OpenShift 4.22+), InPlacePodVerticalScaling is GA and uses the pods/resize subresource. Containers define resizePolicy for cpu and memory (RestartNotRequired or RestartContainer). When a StatefulSet pod is OOMKilled (ExitCode 137) or CPU-throttled causing liveness probe failures, kube-doctor updates the workload resource spec via containers/kubernetes-mcp-server (resources_create_or_update) and patches pods/resize after verifying Namespace ResourceQuota and LimitRange.

title: Handling ResourceQuota, LimitRange, and HPA Ceiling Violations
content: When vertical scaling (OOMKilled bump) or horizontal scaling (HPA ScalingLimited at maxReplicas) is blocked by a Namespace ResourceQuota, LimitRange, or HorizontalPodAutoscaler maxReplicas ceiling, kube-doctor classifies the issue with Policy=APPROVAL_REQUIRED, creates a RemediationRequest CRD (kubedoctor.io/v1alpha1), and opens a GitOps Pull Request to expand the governance boundary before applying the workload change.

category: Cluster Infrastructure, Machine API, Node NotReady & MachineConfigPool
title: OpenShift 4.22+ Missing Machine, Node NotReady (Out-of-Service Taint), and MachineConfigPool Drift
content: In OpenShift 4.22+, worker capacity is managed via MachineSet (machine.openshift.io/v1beta1) and Cluster API (cluster.x-k8s.io/v1beta1). Missing machines trigger an approval-gated resources_scale on MachineSet. For NodeNotReady with unresponsive kubelet, Kubernetes 1.35+ supports the node.kubernetes.io/out-of-service:NoExecute taint to immediately detach RWO VolumeAttachments and reschedule stateful pods. Degraded ClusterOperators and MachineConfigPools are triaged via containers/kubernetes-mcp-server events_list and resources_get.

category: DRA, Native Sidecars, UserNamespaces & CSI Storage
title: Kubernetes 1.35 DRA (resource.k8s.io/v1beta1), Native Sidecars, UserNamespaces, and Online Volume Expansion
content: Kubernetes 1.35+ provides Dynamic Resource Allocation (resource.k8s.io/v1beta1 ResourceClaim, DeviceClass, ResourceSlice) for GPUs/NICs, native SidecarContainers (initContainers with restartPolicy: Always), UserNamespaces (hostUsers: false) integrating with OpenShift 4.22 restricted-v2 SCC, and online CSI volume expansion + VolumeAttributesClass for full PVCs.

category: Networking, OVN-Kubernetes, OpenShift Route, DNS & PDB
title: Service EndpointSlices, OVN-Kubernetes NetworkPolicy, OpenShift Route 503, CoreDNS, and PDB Drain Blockers
content: Covers empty EndpointSlices (selector mismatch), OVN-Kubernetes / AdminNetworkPolicy traffic drops, OpenShift Route 503 targetPort reconciliation, OpenShift DNS Operator cache tuning, ImageDigestMirrorSet (config.openshift.io/v1) for ImagePullBackOff, and Kubernetes 1.35 PDB unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy=AlwaysAllow to unblock node drains.
